notes:
Tatami routing and stitch-generation update.

- Improved fill sequencing around notches and cutouts, with fewer unnecessary jumps and trims. Tested pinned notches now finish without internal cuts; two-opening controls reduce Center Run trims from five to three and Double Zigzag trims from seven to three.
- Keeps connecting paths beneath stitches sewn later. Required underlay stays below the cover, and changing the tested underlay settings retains the same cover geometry.
- Avoids an unnecessary crosswise underlay pass at reserved fill junctions and improves finishing at selected end markers.
- The default hole-control matrix now sews with one initial positioning jump and no internal trims across its 48 tested variations.
- Better compensated approaches and short-return handling, including checks after machine-file rounding.
- Auto Digitize uses the same updated engine as the editor. Installer and portable editions receive the same update.

Offline checks include 291 native tests, 72 compensated-approach profiles, 24 rotated/marker profiles, project reopening and EXP output. Installer, updater, startup and rendering are checked for this release.

Known limitations: full parity is not complete. Complex fills can still use excess jumps, trims or long covered approaches. Some guided fills with holes cannot yet be generated. The wider routing comparison retains 12 failing workflow checks. The retained face comparison still has eight trims, so it is not equivalent to the reference's continuous route. Physical sew-out validation remains deferred. Review the stitch sequence before sewing; machines with trimming disabled may leave connecting threads.
